crossRefs.note: David went out wherever Saul sent him, and behaved himself wisely; and Saul set him over the men of war. It was good in…
They couldn’t find what they might do, for all the people hung on to every word that he said.
The chief priests and the scribes sought to lay hands on him that very hour, but they feared the people—for they knew…
who may go out before them, and who may come in before them, and who may lead them out, and who may bring them in, that…
In times past, when Saul was king over us, it was you who led Israel out and in. Yahweh said to you, ‘You will be…
Now, Yahweh my God, you have made your servant king instead of David my father. I am just a little child. I don’t know…

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Israel

translations.web: But all Israel and Judah loved David; for he went out and came in before them.
